svg.title: Explorer · Builder · Dreamer
svg.desc: A poem. Where there was a mountain, I opened a path: the word MOUNTAIN rises letter by letter into a mountain range, a road is cut through it, and the travellers on the road spell EXPLORER. Where there was a river, I built a bridge: the arch is the word BUILDER, and its reflection in the water is the word DREAMER, upside down. On the other side: another, smaller mountain. Good. Explorer · Builder · Dreamer.
